Good to know

Do the boats come with a crew?

Yes, a skipper is available. You can also rent without crew if your team holds the right qualifications.

Can you deliver abroad?

Yes. The boats are road transportable and fit a 40 ft container. Trading area is worldwide.

Which classification do the boats have?

The Cyclone 8 and 9 are MCA Cat 3 up to 20 miles. The Galactica and Tornado 7 are MCA. See each spec sheet for details.

How fast can I get a quote?

Send the form and Klaas Post replies personally, usually within one working day.
